for FILTER in CTRL_CB.txt KIA2_CB.txt KI36_CB.txt
do
    PREFIX=$(basename "$FILTER" _CB.txt)
    echo "Processing $PREFIX ..."
    # ... your filtering steps ...
    COUNT=$(samtools view -c "${PREFIX}_filtered.bam")
    echo "$PREFIX has $COUNT reads"
done
